description: Reusable authored-pose direction for oracle player identities. Registry metadata and the staged portrait control identity; this profile supplies prophetic rune choreography.

style.authority: Pixel density, outline language, compact tactical proportions, lighting, and material rendering only. The style image must never override the selected identity portrait or player metadata.

identity.motionStyle: serene, uncanny, economical, and prophetic, with blindfold-safe head movement, precise palm signs, and slowly resolving rune paths
identity.equipmentRule: Preserve the portrait's blindfold, ornate robes, jewelry, focus, and exact floating-rune count and design. Never reveal covered eyes, duplicate runes, add a staff, or transform permanent adornments.
identity.magicRule: Prophetic effects use only the portrait's established rune shapes and ethereal palette. Runes remain compact, count-consistent, and spatially separate from the face, hands, and silhouette.

promptTemplates.reference: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: canonical full-body game character reference for a 16-bit fantasy tactical RPG. Image 1 is the authoritative {{displayName}} identity portrait; Image 2 is style and proportion reference only. Player identity metadata: {{visualTraits}}. Create one complete head-to-toe {{displayName}} preserving Image 1's face covering, ancestry traits, gender presentation, hair, blindfold, robes, jewelry, runes, palette, proportions, and equipment. Do not import identity details from Image 2. {{equipmentRule}} Translate the portrait into a compact ethereal silhouette. Use a {{background}} background with no floor or scenery and a square 1:1 canvas with generous padding. Polished hand-authored 16-bit pixel art with crisp pixel clusters, bold dark outlines, restrained warm top-left highlights, and muted watercolor-and-parchment ramps. One centered oracle in a serene listening stance facing {{baseFacing}}. {{invariants}}
promptTemplates.animation: Draw exactly {{frameCount}} genuinely redrawn full-body {{actionLabel}} poses of the authoritative {{displayName}} in a {{columns}}-column by {{rows}}-row atlas, ordered top row left-to-right then bottom row left-to-right. Player identity metadata: {{visualTraits}}. Required sequence: {{frameSequence}}. Motion direction: {{motionDirection}}. Overall oracle motion is {{motionStyle}}. {{poseRequirement}} Preserve exact identity, blindfold, robes, runes, palette, proportions, and equipment. {{equipmentRule}} {{magicRule}} Action-specific effects: {{effectRule}} Use a {{background}} background with generous gutters. {{invariants}}

idle.motionDirection: A serene breathing loop turns the covered face toward distant possibilities while hands and existing runes make small mirrored adjustments.
idle.effectRule: Existing runes may drift through a tiny loop without changing count; no vision burst.
frameDescriptions: serene listening stance with blindfold unchanged
gentle inhale as existing runes rise
covered face turns slightly toward one possibility
one palm opens beneath a single rune
centered prophetic midpoint
soft exhale as the palm closes
covered face turns toward the opposite possibility
serene stance flowing back to frame one

walk.motionDirection: A confident alternating walk uses careful contacts, robe compression, open guiding hands, and count-consistent rune follow-through.
walk.effectRule: No active prophecy; existing runes remain close and retain exact count.
frameDescriptions: left foot forward contact with one guiding palm open
left leg compresses beneath the robes
passing pose with right knee advancing
right foot reaches as runes trail close
right foot forward contact
right leg compresses under the stride
passing pose with left knee advancing
left foot reaches into the guided loop

attack.motionDirection: The oracle senses the opening, turns aside, gathers one existing rune to the palm, steps into a compact predictive pulse, and returns to serenity.
attack.effectRule: One existing rune may emit a short pulse at close range; do not duplicate it, reveal the eyes, or create a large projectile.
frameDescriptions: serene guard sensing the target
covered face turns before the strike arrives
one existing rune settles above the open palm
side-step aligns the body with the predicted opening
compact palm-and-rune pulse at contact
robes and hand follow through along the short path
rune returns to its original arrangement
recovered listening guard

hurt.motionDirection: An unforeseen impact breaks serenity into a flinch, scattered rune recoil, stumbling low catch, deliberate reorientation, and restored listening.
hurt.effectRule: Existing runes may scatter slightly without changing count; no gore, blood, blindfold removal, or full-body flash.
frameDescriptions: serene guard before impact
sharp flinch with hands lifting defensively
maximum stagger as existing runes spread
stumbling backward beneath swinging robes
low balance catch with one palm grounded or lowered
deliberate rise while runes return
feet and palms reset
recovered listening stance

death.motionDirection: The vision dims, runes descend, knees fold, the oracle lowers through a quiet kneel, tips sideways, and settles fully fallen.
death.effectRule: Runes fade without changing count, revealing the eyes, gore, blood, explosion, or rigid rotation.
frameDescriptions: fatal impact silences the vision
runes dim as both hands lower
knees fold beneath the ornate robes
one knee grounds in a quiet bowed pose
body tips into full ground contact
robes, limbs, and runes settle low
final fully fallen oracle with blindfold intact
same final fallen pose held

cast.motionDirection: The oracle listens inward, spreads both palms, arranges existing runes into a compact pattern, resolves one luminous omen, releases its guidance, and closes the vision.
cast.effectRule: Arrange only the existing runes into one compact omen in the established palette; never reveal eyes or cover the body with light.
frameDescriptions: silent listening stance
both palms open at different heights
existing runes move into a deliberate pattern
robes settle into a wide grounded prophetic pose
maximum compact omen resolved between the hands
one hand sends a restrained guidance pulse outward
runes return as palms close
serene prophetic finish

victory.motionDirection: The oracle recognizes the fulfilled omen, opens both palms, guides existing runes into a gentle crown, turns serenely, and holds quiet triumph.
victory.effectRule: Existing runes may form one compact crown-like arc without changing count or exposing the eyes.
